svg.text: MODERN polygons-in-contact (PIC) exercise, method per Kaplan & Salesin, 'Islamic Star Patterns in Absolute Geometry', ACM ToG 23(2) (2004): 97-119 (contact angle 72 deg). Historical record: Topkapi Scroll MS H.1956 (Necipoglu 1995) and Hankin (1925) - PIC is a modern inference from that record, not a documented maker procedure. Quasiperiodicity claims (Lu & Steinhardt 2007) are DISPUTED: see Makovicky, Science 318 (2007): 1383, and Cromwell, Math. Intelligencer 37(4) (2015): 30-44.
MODERN EXERCISE - generated teaching artifact; not a historical artifact and not a reconstruction claim.
